ordered_diagnoses: ELANE-associated severe congenital neutropenia with hepatic involvement

s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent fever with abdominal involvement and liver pathology
salient_findings: Liver palpable 4 cm below rib margin with tenderness on percussion
Abnormal liver imaging with patchy low-density shadow and honeycomb enhancement
key_facts: Developed fever one week after receiving measles vaccine
Fever initially resolved with Cefuroxime Axetil Granules
Past medical history includes pneumonia, duodenal bulb ulcer, erosive gastritis, and Staphylococcus aureus septicemia and infective endocarditis
Heterozygous mutation in exon 3 of the ELANE gene
Liver tissue showed scattered hepatic structures with focal abscess changes
Culture from liver lesion: Positive for Staphylococcus aureus

s4.champion: ELANE-associated severe congenital neutropenia with hepatic involvement

raw.champion: ELANE-associated severe congenital neutropenia with hepatic involvement
raw.rationale: The presence of a heterozygous mutation in exon 3 of the ELANE gene, recurrent fevers, and laboratory findings such as rare neutrophils on the blood film are consistent with ELANE-associated severe congenital neutropenia. The hepatic involvement, as evidenced by the liver lesion and positive culture for Staphylococcus aureus, further supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Severe Congenital Neutropenia
rejected.why: While the patient has features of severe congenital neutropenia, the specific mention of an ELANE gene mutation and hepatic involvement points more specifically to ELANE-associated severe congenital neutropenia with hepatic involvement

rejected.label: Pyogenic Liver Abscess
rejected.why: Although the patient has a liver abscess, this diagnosis alone does not account for the broader clinical picture of recurrent fevers, neutropenia, and the genetic mutation

rejected.label: Cyclic Neutropenia
rejected.why: Cyclic neutropenia is characterized by periodic episodes of neutropenia, but the patient's presentation and the genetic findings are more indicative of a congenital neutropenia syndrome like ELANE-associated severe congenital neutropenia

rejected.label: Chronic Granulomatous Disease
rejected.why: This condition is characterized by recurrent infections due to defective neutrophil function, but the genetic mutation and specific pattern of neutropenia and hepatic involvement in this case are more consistent with ELANE-associated severe congenital neutropenia
